The interface table opens with a banner and a row of column names. The
two together are what identify it:

Kernel Interface table
Iface             MTU    RX-OK RX-ERR RX-DRP RX-OVR    TX-OK TX-ERR TX-DRP TX-OVR Flg

Releases before 2.0 wrote a metric between the MTU and the counters, and
cut the interface name at five characters, so the same table read:

Iface   MTU Met   RX-OK RX-ERR RX-DRP RX-OVR   TX-OK TX-ERR TX-DRP TX-OVR Flg

Neither is output on its own; both are quoted here so that a reader can
tell which release a capture came from.
